title: 3D Executed Villager
description: This texture pack replaces old and boring totem of undying to a new and cool villager head on a chain
body:
This texture pack changed the old and boring totem of undying with a new and cool 3d model of a villager with a chain

this texture pack doesn't contain any actual gore, only light and unrealistic blood.

the best way to support it is by hearting the mod :)
